notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.042
notes.notes: [h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]S&F Account: [/b]When logging into an S&F account, leading and trailing spaces in the account name and password are now ignored. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat[/b]: Reward drop chances are now displayed for all rewards in the fight preview screen. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Heroes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]When all enemies have the “Shroud” status effect, the game will now display shroud info texts above all affected enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some misleading hero skill descriptions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Events[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]The event portal is now properly grayed out when it has not yet been unlocked. [/p][/*][*][p]Clicking on the unlocked event portal while no event is running now provides a short info text. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixed Bugs[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Interface/Display[/b]: The shimmer icon is no longer displayed on empty hero slots (hero selection in combats and divine alignment in the chapel).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magic Toilet:[/b] During toilet resource spend events, you now instantly see the rewards obtained after spending souls or event souls in draws. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Disconnections[/b]: Fixed an issue that caused unwanted S&F account logouts after a period of inactivity when using SSO methods and keeping the game running in the background. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Adventure Rank:[/b] Clicking the “Reach Adventure Rank 52” quest now correctly opens the adventure screen instead of doing nothing. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Heroes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Hephaestus and Taurus no longer grant themselves the status effect “Guard”. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the tongue of Medusa was always visible in the portrait image.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.041
notes.notes: [h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Equipment[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]AP bonus increased to 65% for the Rotten Maul (Unique Weapon).[/p][/*][*][p]Proc chance increased to 70% at Mythic rarity for the following weapons: Arcane Codex, Clawtastrophe, and Tusk Fang (Unique Weapons).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Chaos Tower[/b]: Various visual improvements to the Chaos Tower.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixed Bugs[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Chaos Tower:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Chaos Tower now resets at 2 AM CEST instead of midnight (already fixed this Tuesday).[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed an issue causing fight verification errors in the Chaos Tower - Errors should now occur significantly less often.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug where the Chaos Tower would display floor 251 after being completed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Guild Hunt[/b]: The Equinox and Star Breaker equipment chests from Guild Hunt now correctly grant their respective sets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heroes[/b]: Isolde's secondary skill now correctly dispels all personal buffs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gacha[/b]: Hero tokens now display correctly in the detail view for the Gacha system (Toilet).[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.039
notes.notes: [h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Region[/b]: The new region Tusk Mountain has been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Event Portal[/b]: A new building has appeared in the village! The Event Portal is now your gateway to many new and exciting upcoming events.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Gacha Boosters[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]This item will be available in the Magic Toilet Shop (at the Trader) after the next shop reset![/p][/*][*][p]These boosters will also be available as rewards in some of the upcoming events.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Performance[/b]: Asset compression has been optimized, and various individual assets have been improved to boost performance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interface/Display[/b]: For better clarity, the hero's rarity is now displayed in the hero list title.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixed Bugs[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Guild Hunt[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the Sentinel Fight in a Guild Hunt to freeze if Anubis' passive skill was used.[/p][/*][*][p]The Guild Hunt reward screen now shows the correct upcoming reward.[/p][/*][*][p]Star Breaker’s (Sentinel) final phases now grant the correct amount of Essence.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Combat[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Unique perks that activate with an ultimate skill will now execute correctly, even if the ultimate does not perform an attack (e.g., Arcane Codex).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Heroes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused Davy Jane's ultimate to attack targets twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Succubus's talent assignment has been corrected and now work with her skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Doctress now correctly heals herself on Critical Hits with her primary skill.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Smith[/b]: The Smithy will no longer open incorrectly when redirecting from the Tavern if it has not been unlocked yet.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stage[/b]: Stage 5-B2 now gives the correct reward.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.035
notes.notes:
To see the entirety of the Changelog for this week‘s update, go visist our help center: https://playa-games.helpshift.com/hc/faq/449

[b]New Features[/b]

- Region: New Area "Busted Lands" is available.
- Level: New max. level 120 is available.

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]

- Status Effects: Resolved an issue where the "Blind" status effect was not functioning as intended. A unit afflicted with Blind now has an increased chance to miss when attacking other units. Additionally, the accuracy of units attacking a blinded target is no longer affected.
- Heroes:
-- The HP modifier for the Dracula boss has been reduced by approximately 15%.
-- Fixed a timing issue with the animation of Krampus' Ultimate Skill.
- Tavern: Resolved an issue where a hero's experience bar progress was not displayed correctly in the tavern.
- Titans:
-- Adjusted the positions of the following animations in Titan battles:
--- Hell Rider (Headless Horseman)
--- Bloodbats (Dracula)
--- Mystic Fire (Loki)
- Graphics: Resolved graphical artifacts that appeared during the second narrative stage in Nevermoor.
- UI:
-- Fixed multiple button scaling inconsistencies.
-- Fixed a bug where the key icon on certain buttons would progressively enlarge under specific circumstances.
-- Corrected scaling issues with the "Reset" and "Ascend" tabs in the chapel.
- Chests: Resolved an issue where a Regular Stage Chest occasionally displayed animations intended for an Ad Chest.

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.034
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Support Button: We have added a support button to the login screen, making it easier to get help in case of unexpected issues.
[*] Backend: Technical Preparations for Upcoming Updates.
[/list]

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]

[list]
[*] Inventory: Fixed an issue where certain resources were not sorted correctly in the inventory.
[*] Inventory: Fixed an issue in the equipment inventory that allowed players to scroll down indefinitely.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.033
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Inventory: Added an inventory to the game, giving you an overview of the resources you have collected - you can access the inventory by clicking on the small bag icon in the village screen.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Dungeons: Upon a hero death, the Replacement Screen now sorts heroes by level first, then rarity - this allows auto mode to pick the highest-level hero instead of favoring rarity over level.
[/list]

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]

[list]
[*] Hero:
[*] -- Shieldmaiden now does not apply “Guard” to herself anymore, when using “Guardian's Vow”.
[*] -- Dr. Pestilence now correctly heals the ally with the lowest HP, when using "Outbreak".
[*] -- Dummy now correctly attacks the same enemy twice, instead of attacking two random targets.
[*] -- Wendigo now correctly deals critical damage to frozen units with all attacks - previously, only its first attack dealt critical damage to frozen units.
[*] -- Isolde’s “The Star” buff now correctly applies a 100% AP buff - previously, it only applied a 50% AP buff.
[*] -- Davy Jane’s Ultimate now attacks the main target and attacks another random target if the first target has the debuff “burn” or “cursed” - before, it only hit one random target.
[*] Status Effects:
[*] -- The ACC Down debuff now correctly decreases Accuracy by 40%. Among others, this affects the Orcopter skill “Target Practice”. Skill description has been adjusted accordingly.
[*] -- Boss Damage Reduction is now displayed correctly in the Stats overview. Previously the value for Boss Damage was also displayed for Boss Damage Reduction.
[*] Behavior Editor: Fixed an issue where the tooltip for skills was opened each time a skill was added to the pattern, even without holding down the skill icon.
[*] Milestone Rewards: The Collect All Rewards screen from the Adventure Rank rewards was sometimes shown twice - it will now only be displayed once.
[*] Payment: All “Purchase has been credited” messages now correctly show the items, that have been bought, at the bottom of the message - previously, some of these messages did not include the purchased items in the message.
[*] Trader: Fixed an issue, where the description of the wrong chest was sometimes shown in the trader when the info button was clicked a couple of times.
[*] Blacksmith: When clicking the icon to expand the item selection at the blacksmith, it previously had the wrong state sometimes - this bug has been fixed.
[*] Regions: The tourist in the Rotten Lands was moved from the left side to the right side of the screen - previously he was mirrored, so the text in his book could not be read.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.032
notes.notes:
To see the entirety of the Changelog for this week‘s update, go visist our help center: https://playa-games.helpshift.com/hc/faq/435

[b]New Features[/b]

- Behavior Editor: Players can now set up the skill execution order for each individual hero for the auto-battle mode (ex: You set up heroes individually to start battles with their Ultimates).
- Tavern: Added a new “Compare” button that clearly displays how the hero's stats will change when equipping a selected item, showing all stat differences side-by-side.

[b]Improvements[/b]

- Tavern: Players can now tap any stat in the hero's detail view to see a simple explanation of what it does.
- Quests Update: Many changes have been done and will only apply to generated quests after the update (please read the entirety of the changelog in Helpshift)
- Equipment: AP Damage Reduction Perk: Buffed across all sources, including set effects. Its max cap has also been increased.

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]

- Quests: The Guild Quests are now always displayed correctly when entering the Guild Quests screen.
- Skills: Fixed a minor issue with Arachne's ultimate ability cooldown.

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.030
notes.notes:
[b]New features[/b]

[list]
[*] Milestone Rewards: Leveling up your character now rewards you with in game rewards at every new adventure rank you reach.
[*] Milestone Rewards: Rewards are granted retroactively - so look forward to a bunch of them if you have been playing already!
[*] Milestone Rewards: The rewards are bundled into the following brackets: 1 - 15, 16 - 30, and 31 - 45 (more will be added in the future).
[*] Milestone Rewards: are free for everyone - and there is the option to buy an additional premium reward lane for more rewards!
[*] New world: W4 with new starter heroes.
[*] Starter Heroes: The new starter heroes are also available to every player in the starter and default banners.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Ad Chests: Improved the rewards you get when opening chests received from watching ads in the game, making them much more rewarding.
[*] Ad Chests: The equipment received will now be of a higher level.
[*] Ad Chests: Gold, scrolls and essence from the ad chests will now increase based on your adventure rank.
[*] Chests: When you receive multiple rewards with some being chests, the chests are now opened directly afterwards to display their contents.
[*] Guild Rewards: We increased the amount of essence you get from the guild quest rewards in all cases.
[/list]

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]

[list]
[*] Tutorial: Fixed a bug where leveling up your hero in the tutorial was not possible in some circumstances.
[*] Equipment: Fixed a bug where upgrading equipment sometimes resulted in a “costs do not match” error.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.029
notes.notes:
[b]New features[/b]

[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[/list]

[list]

[*] Smith: Fixed an issue that caused the weapon dust cost to be low for enhancing weapons.
[*] Smith: The new perk info was shown for some items, even though the item already had 4 perks (or had a unique perk/set perks and 3 other perks) - this has been fixed.
[*] Localization: The text string “Unique” for unique items is now properly localized in all languages.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.028
notes.notes:
[i]We are releasing a Hotfix update 1.028 today, which will be deployed at 1:00 PM CET.[/i]

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]

[list]
[*] Combat: Fixed the AP stealing giving the caster more AP than it actually stole from targets.
[*] Items Dialog: The dialog was missing; therefore, we removed line breaks from resource numbers.
[*] Chapel: "Max Upgrade" and "Max Skill Level" numbers are now properly displayed again.
[*] Tavern: Fixed hero name banner looking broken for some long hero names.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.027
notes.notes:
To see the entirety of the Changelog for this week‘s update, go visist our help center: https://playa-games.helpshift.com/hc/faq/424


[b]Improvements[/b]

- Release of the entire Equipment Rework - please review the full changelog via the link above.
- General Balancing (PvE): Enemies now have increased defenses to counterbalance the improved player strength from the equipment rework.
- Warnings & Safeguards: Added a confirmation prompt when consuming an equipped item during refinement and dismantling.

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]

- Perks: RES and ACC perk calculations have been corrected, reducing previous over-inflation of those stats.
- Combat: If a wave ends before the active unit has executed an active skill, the unit can now carry it over to the next wave - this fixes the issue for Thor's Mjöllnir and Black Skull Overlord’s passive.
- Resource Info Dialog: Sometimes opens the wrong Titan difficulty when clicking on a Titan.

[i]Winter is leaving - snow has been removed from the village background.[/i]
